definitions.fallback: Sum contributions modulo 71**7; if that residue is zero use the independently verified training-only fitted default. Zero coefficients do not enter either predicate. Zero/one-active cases are reported separately.
definitions.negatives: Saved coefficients are canonical residues 0<=w<71**7. Signed equivalents must be reduced modulo 71**depth, never replaced with abs(w). No claim of disjoint infinite Z_p supports.
definitions.powers: Pairwise-disjoint nonzero canonical digits at positions 0 through 6 of coefficients modulo 71**7.
definitions.preprocessing: Use the frozen product-tag relation and exact feature order used by saved fits. Snapshot construction already uppercases, deduplicates and removes substring-nested tags before anonymisation; never reparse mutable raw tags or filter anonymous IDs as strings.
definitions.sensitivity: Depths 1..7 change only the support predicate, never predictions, loss or the valuation predicate. Report hidden contributions and fully-visible subgroups to expose truncation vacuity.
definitions.valuation: Distinct valuations of nonzero active coefficients, counted once per binary feature.

model_description: Saved first complete association-ordered sweep of the exact finite-quotient coordinate fitter; NOT the published floating-point one-pass greedy fit.

results.aggregation: Pooled rows are product-weighted; by_fold also preserves each fold separately.
results.interpretation: Descriptive post-hoc association; neither predicate was imposed in fitting. No causal claim.
